_note: Optional overrides for the page elements content.js presses and reads. Each key takes one CSS selector or a list tried in order. Keys: likeRoot, like, dislike, ytLike, ytDislike, shuffle, repeat, adSkip, ytmTitle, ytmByline, ytmArt, ytTitle, ytChannel, playPause. Leave "selectors" empty to use the built-in ones. Changes apply within 10 minutes on open tabs, with no extension update. Bump "version" when you change something.
